patterns.mechanism: At formal_contract, only mechanical_failure and missing_requirement are permitted. There is no target_case execution of the Lean reference at this checkpoint.
patterns.next_measure: Introduce a separately scoped reference/request conformance probe with concrete input, reference result and exact request clause; define independent authority for the expected behavior instead of using proof failure as a proxy. priority_interpretation: Main coverage bottleneck is reaching valid faithful formal artifacts: completed strict arms commonly stop before any code.
The concrete-review API must express reference/request mismatch; valid proofs of wrong or vacuous models currently cannot be refuted through proof-soundness probes.
Agent repair prompts and review source packets must retain authoritative new evidence rather than stale or irrelevant data.
Provider context/end-reason observability and transport receipts must distinguish real generation defects from infrastructure censoring.
Accounting/report-shape regressions should prevent false qualification rejection but do not repair semantic coverage.
scope: Read-only retained provider/context/review/transport/accounting and repair-feedback analysis. No models, candidate/kernel/checker execution, historical rescoring or repository writes.
units: Task slots and completed strict-arm records are attempts, not distinct software tasks. Development cohorts use changing sources/transports, so counts are descriptive catalogs, not pooled causal success rates.
